products.name: Netskope Client Deployment & Traffic Steering at Scale (Intune) — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable way to deploy the Netskope client and traffic steering at scale through Intune — packaged deployment, steering and exception config, health validation, and ringed rollout to thousands of endpoints. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Roll out the Netskope client to thousands of devices — steered correctly, from day one

A SASE platform only works if its client is actually on every device, healthy, and steering the right traffic. Done by hand, agent rollouts stall: clients fail to enroll, steering configs are inconsistent, and exceptions break business apps. This solution gives you a repeatable way to deploy the Netskope client and traffic steering at scale through Microsoft Intune — packaged deployment, steering and exception configuration, health validation, and ringed rollout to thousands of endpoints.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Netskope client and steering model, Intune-based deployment, steering configuration and exceptions, client health, and the ringed large-scale rollout.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Netskope tenant, Intune, Entra ID, client enrollment method/credentials, steering config, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: package and deploy the client via Intune, configure steering and exceptions, validate client health and steering, ring the rollout, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — client-readiness discovery, client-health and steering validation, a deployment status and exception report, safe remediation of failed/unhealthy clients, and a rollout-ring group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

The Netskope client on every device, healthy and steering correctly — deployed through Intune in safe rings with exceptions that don't break business apps — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • NSCLIENT-Discovery.ps1 — Netskope client deployment readiness for this device
    • NSCLIENT-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation for a failed/unhealthy Netskope client on this device
    • NSCLIENT-Report.ps1 — fleet-wide deployment status for the Netskope client app + cert coverage (Graph)
    • NSCLIENT-Set-RolloutRingTargeting.ps1 — build/preview the rollout-ring Entra groups (Microsoft Graph)
    • NSCLIENT-Validation.ps1 — confirm the Netskope client is installed, running, enrolled, and steering

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
